structure: One short ruling file, workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-11-04.md, 22 lines in total. It is laid out as the ruling layout of references/DISTIL.md section 6: an H1 heading ("Ruling: Sam, 4 November 2026"), then two context sentences each followed by a verbatim block quote of Sam's own words, then a numbered list of 4 claims the main session read from those quotes. The first context sentence and quote cover splitting the "What are you importing?" type question off the type question and templates theme (EUDPA-690) after templates was de-prioritised; the quote is one sentence ("split off the what are you improting page from the templates stuff. handle it nicely in a new theme I think."). The second context sentence and quote cover the two type question rows held as deferred since the 12 October pause (the origin page's Back link, and Back from a review Change link); the quote is two sentences covering: include deferred rows if in doubt, all rows on one branch, do not merge it even if finished, and links must work in CDP as well as the local Docker stack and the CI Docker stack. The 4 numbered claims are: templates de-prioritised and parked in themes/type-question-and-templates; the type question rows build in themes/type-question on branch feat/EUDPA-690-type-question in every repo they touch with the two deferred rows included as to do; the branch is not merged when its last row lands and Sam merges it; every link, redirect and form hand-over between services works in CDP, the local Docker stack and the CI Docker stack, each taking its address from the service's own configuration and never a hard-coded host or port. Each numbered claim is marked "New.", so none answers a question or conflict from an earlier report. The scope is "whole file", so nothing in the file is left out; the file carries no tables, images or links to other documents, and the ruling says nothing about page content, wording, layout or question order beyond the "What are you importing?" page being split into its own theme.

covers: Quote 1, on the type question split: "split off the what are you improting page from the templates stuff. handle it nicely in a new theme I think." — what it decides about moving the "What are you importing?" page out of the type question and templates theme (EUDPA-690) and into a new theme

Quote 2, on the deferred rows, the branch and the environments: "if in doubt include them. all the rows go on one branch and dont merge it if you happen to finish. dont let the stuff forget links etc need to work in CDP as well as local docker stack and CI docker stack" — each decision it makes, taken separately: include the doubtful/deferred rows, one branch for all the rows, do not merge the branch on finishing, and links working in CDP, the local Docker stack and the CI Docker stack

Numbered claim 1: templates is de-prioritised, its rows stay parked in themes/type-question-and-templates and are not built now — checked against the quotes, with the statement marked verbatim or inferred accordingly

Numbered claim 2: the type question rows build in their own theme themes/type-question, on one branch feat/EUDPA-690-type-question, in every repo they touch, with the two deferred rows (the origin page's Back link, and Back from a review Change link) included as to do — checked against the quotes; the theme name, branch name and the two rows' identity come from the context sentences, so say what in the quotes supports each
Numbered claim 3: the branch is not merged when its last row lands; Sam merges it — checked against quote 2

Numbered claim 4: every link, redirect and form hand-over between services works in all three environments (CDP, the local Docker stack, the CI Docker stack the pull request end-to-end runs use), each taking its address from the service's own configuration as the existing links between services do, and never from a hard-coded host or port — checked against quote 2, noting which of "redirect", "form hand-over", "own configuration" and "never hard-coded" the quote says in so many words and which it only implies
Each claim's ref as the file and its list item, such as "ruling-sam-2026-11-04.md claim 2", and for a claim read from a quote alone the quote's line

Any question or floated idea in the quotes recorded as a gap claim, not a decision — in particular the hedge "handle it nicely in a new theme I think" and "if in doubt include them": say whether each is a decision or an open point

Any point the ruling touches but leaves open, as a gap claim with an empty quote — for example what "handle it nicely" requires of the new theme, which repos the branch spans, when or on what condition Sam merges the branch, and what happens to the parked templates rows
That every numbered claim is marked "New.", so no claim answers a report question or conflict and no such note is invented
